name: rewind_gold1991_v2
about: Rupee Rewind 3 Nov 2026 (India's 1991 gold pledge), script v2 for suspense: split cliffhanger lines, long held beats before 'defaults' and 'for a country', a tape-rewind into 1991, a low heartbeat pulse through the crisis, a riser + music drop before the key line. Same facts and sources as pipeline/episodes/story_20261103.py (notes/rupee_rewind/2026-11-03_selection.md). Research pass: long pledge line split, one idea per line.

lines.text: Gold just hit a one-year low...
days before Dhanteras.
But in nineteen ninety-one... India had to pawn its own gold.
Just to pay its bills.
Nineteen ninety-one. India is running out of dollars.
What's left pays for just a few weeks of imports.
Run out...
and India defaults.
First, twenty tonnes of gold seized from smugglers is sold...
with a promise to buy it back.
About two hundred million dollars.
Not enough.
So the RBI takes a bigger step.
It pledges forty-seven tonnes of its own gold.
With the Bank of England... and the Bank of Japan.
The gold leaves the country.
As a guarantee.
In return? About four hundred million dollars in loans.
A pawn shop...
for a country.
That July, the rupee is cut in value...
and India starts opening up its economy.
And in twenty twenty-four?
The RBI moved about a hundred tonnes of its gold from the UK... back home to India.
So gold isn't just jewellery. In a crisis, you can borrow against it.
But the real lesson?
Keep cash for emergencies... so you never have to pawn the gold.
And for India... it all began with the dollars running out.
